description: Applies the width/height previously copied into WireframeClipboard to the selected elements. Undoable.

members.name: PasteSizeCommand
members.description: Creates the command for the selected element ids.

members.name: Name
members.description: Human-readable label shown in undo/redo tooltips.

members.name: Execute
members.description: Applies the change to the document.

members.name: Undo
members.description: Restores the state captured before Execute() ran.

examples.title: Use PasteSizeCommand
examples.code:
new CopyStyleCommand(sourceElement, includeSize: true).Execute();
commandStack.Push(new PasteSizeCommand(document, selectedIds));
